budget.accounting: Token-usage multiplied by dated endpoint-aware rates; explicitly estimated. User authorized approximation after actual-cost API returned HTTP403.
budget.actualBillingFallback: Arc signed-in dashboard filtered to dev env key; optional provider-reported CSV reconciliation. No claim of programmatic billing access.
budget.unpricedCostPolicy: Stop further admission when usage or pricing is incomplete; retain all partial results.
budget.externalAwsCost: Lambda modeled estimate included; other AWS or marketplace/index/storage costs not claimed as actual.

analysis.primary: All hard observable obligations met / all scheduled conversations; report functional failures and invalid measurement separately.
analysis.uncertainty: 10000 fixed-seed stratified scenario-cluster bootstrap; preserve all repetitions and ratio-of-sums denominators.
analysis.claimBoundary: Designed regression-informed technical benchmark, not customer satisfaction, comprehensive prose faithfulness, or causal optimization improvement.
analysis.historicalPopulation: July V4 retained separately; no regrading or pooling.
analysis.freeze: Freeze resolved cases/fixtures/prompt/evaluator/lockfile/KB identities and deployed artifact/config before first paid call. No tuning between repetitions. Later fixes require a separate study.
analysis.providerPopulation: Eight live public provider read scenarios and two controlled fixture scenarios. All customer/effect mutations mocked. Report live-read and controlled providers separately; do not claim frozen-catalog determinism.
